data_fields.name: ambient_entry_weights
data_fields.donor_constant: integer chance per name:chance entry (config key ambient_sfx)

data_fields.name: combat_mutes_ambient
data_fields.donor_constant: isInCombat() clears the chosen index (timer keeps running)

data_fields.name: music_fade_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 2000 (code present, flag never set in donor)

best_idea: A per-zone weighted ambient list driven by a self-rescheduling 15-to-20-second timer that rolls its next sound one interval early and goes silent while combat runs.
decision_why: Frankendom zones need ambience that is data per zone, and the donor's weighted list with a combat mute is the right shape; the donor has defects (a node allocated before early returns, a gap stamped on blocked attempts, an inclusive draw that can match nothing), and it has no priority over the shared four voices, so the fix is in the sketch and the list goes into zone data.
acceptance: In a zone with ambient weights crow 3 and wind 1, a crow or wind plays about every 15 to 20 seconds of game time while exploring, and nothing plays while the hero is in combat; a test with a fake clock that advances 4 seconds between plays asserts only one plays.
